Name: Ore Fish
Author: dedpeech
Description:
[size=4]Adds four new fish based off of their respective ores in game. These fish can be found at various locations.  These fish are vanilla fish recoloured to look like their respective ores.[/size]

[size=4]catch conditions:[/size]
[spoiler][size=4]Copper Ore fish can be caught at level 20 in the mines at any time.
Iron Ore fish can be caught at the beach in seasons fall and winter.
Gold Ore fish can be caught in the secret woods in seasons summer and fall.
Iridium Ore fish can be caught in the desert at any time.
**to catch each fish you must catch the fish before. [/size][/spoiler]

special thanks to the stardew valley discord and huskyn1nja for letting me ask questions.

Please do not use AI to translate or make new assets for this mod.
